# opsramp_integration_inbound_properties (Data Source)

Retrieves the available inbound entity properties for an installed integration. These properties represent the valid values for opsramp_attribute in map_attributes blocks.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) The ID of the installed integration (e.g. INTG-...).

### Optional

- `entity` (String) The entity type to retrieve properties for. Defaults to ALERT.

### Read-Only

- `properties` (Attributes List) The list of available properties for attribute mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of the property.
- `display_group` (String) The display group (e.g. NATIVE_ATTRIBUTE).
- `mapable` (Boolean) Whether the property can be mapped.
- `name` (String) The display name of the property.
- `parsable` (Boolean) Whether the property supports parsing operators.
- `property` (String) The property identifier (e.g. alert.alertTime). Use this as the opsramp_attribute value.
- `property_type` (String) The data type of the property (e.g. STRING).
- `value_mapable` (Boolean) Whether specific values of this property can be mapped.
